question: Should WhatsApp reconnect catch-up replies be enabled by default through this bounded active-reconnect window, or should this behavior remain behind an explicit operator opt-in policy?
rationale: The patch is a focused fix for message loss, but it intentionally changes default delivery semantics for existing WhatsApp users and older related PRs proposed an opt-in configuration model instead.

options.title: Accept Bounded Default Recovery
options.body: Land the no-config bounded reconnect window after proof and cleanup, accepting that recent Baileys-delivered catch-up appends may auto-reply by default after active reconnects.

options.title: Require Opt-In Policy
options.body: Pause this PR and redesign the behavior behind explicit operator configuration so existing users keep stale append suppression unless they opt in.

options.title: Defer To Broader Backfill Work
options.body: Keep this PR unmerged if maintainers want only provider-side history-sync or gap-warning work to solve the canonical issue.

recommendation.title: Accept Bounded Default Recovery
recommendation.body: Land the no-config bounded reconnect window after proof and cleanup, accepting that recent Baileys-delivered catch-up appends may auto-reply by default after active reconnects.
